turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You will not say such things, O-lan. You are my wife, my partner, and my love. I will not hear you speak of yourself as a slave.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not speak so, you are not just a slave, you are my mother and I will take care of you

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will see to it, honored mother, that your things are put in order and your son is married and settled before...before you are gone.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad that my son will be taken care of, and that he will be married and settled soon.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not speak of settling my son's marriage. You are the one who has taught him the ways of a good man, and I will not have him married before you are gone.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Father, you must not be so sad, Mother will be watching over us from the other world, and I will take care of everything as she has taught me.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Honored father, I will make sure to keep the household in order and prepare for the marriage as Mother has instructed.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have thought of this, Wang Lung, and I know that my son must be married and settled soon, so that he can have sons of his own and carry on our family's name.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you planning for my son's future as if I were already gone, O-lan. You must rest and let me take care of these things.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Please, Mother, do not tire yourself thinking of my marriage. I will speak to the matchmaker and make sure that everything is arranged as you wish.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will try to help, honored mother, by keeping the household in order and preparing for the marriage, as you have instructed.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have thought of the marriage, Wang Lung, and I know that it is not just a matter of speaking to the matchmaker. We must also think of the price of the dowry, and how we will pay for the wedding feast.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you worrying about the dowry and the wedding feast, O-lan. These things will be taken care of, and you must not exhaust yourself thinking about them.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I am sure that Father and the matchmaker will find a suitable bride for me, and I will do my part to make the marriage a happy one.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will go to the market today, honored mother, and see if I can find some vegetables to make a soup for you, as you have been feeling poorly.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have been thinking about the dowry, Wang Lung, and I believe we should use the silver from the old family treasure to pay for it, so that our son's future is secure.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not even think of taking the silver from the old family treasure. We will find another way to pay for the dowry, and it will not be at the cost of our family's legacy.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Do not worry, Mother, I am sure Father will find a way to pay for the dowry without using the family treasure. I will do my part to help with the wedding preparations and make sure everything goes smoothly.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Honored mother, I will also try to find some herbs to help with your... your breathing. I have heard that they can make it easier to breathe.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have been feeling so tired, Wang Lung. I fear I will not be well enough to see our son married and settled. But I must see it done, for his future, for our family.
